decision: 10 second time penalty. (10 seconds added to elapsed Sprint time). 2 penalty points (total of 2 for the 12 month period). Reason The Stewards reviewed video and in-car video evidence. The driver of Car 27 attempted an overtake on Car 14 into Turn 3 but locked up and missed the apex. The Car understeered to the very edge of the track, thereby preventing Car 14 from turning in and forcing the other driver off track.
fact: Car 27 forced Car 14 off track at turn 3.
offence: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 b) of the International Sporting Code.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 27 Forcing Car 14 Off The Track
to: The Team Manager, MoneyGram Haas F1 Team
